post_details: Hi , I am trying to to delete half of a pattern so that I can unfold an updated half. I can delete all points, but one. A window pops up. I can t seem to get around this Please can you let me know how to resolve this? Thanks in advance

comments.comment_body: Did you try cutting the pattern along what will be the fold line. I would do that, then delete the unwanted half, and then unfold. Not sure why this message is occurring (hopefully someone can explain), but sometimes it's hard to get at the last bit something. I had one notch that I wanted to delete, and I couldn't seem to select it.
Why delete the points when you can just draw an internal line (shortcut G) in the middle and then right click&gtCut and then delete one half?

If you have a reference associated within half of the pattern you are trying to delete, that is associated to the whole pattern piece (eg: notch point and sewing line), it will not do it, as that may destroy the other half with an associated ref. so it's kind of a failsafe that maybe looks at the symmetry line, and asymmetry preventing you from deleting that stray reference that may be important for another construction issue (eg: sewing). When that happens it can take longer to find the culprit point than actually taking a bit of drastic action and creating a new symmetry point, deleting the stray point and unfolding a new half, and redoing the sewing line to the notches to get a whole pattern again.

post_title: Render quality. Light settings. Please check.
post_details: Hi everyone. I am a beginner but am learning a lot myself. This model is my first presentation. Therefore, I have questions for the result. I tried to expose the light, but there are blackouts. I tried with dome light (environment map - studio_highcontrast.hdr) achieve realism. When the photo is enlarged, the texture is not visible. But perhaps it should be, since the texture is very fine. Please tell me how it should be right. I am attaching all the settings that I made. Normal map is cotton_gabardine_nrm I would be grateful for any advice and recommendations. Thank. P.S. The physical volume of the render photo is 5.6 MB. Reduced to 2 MB to fit in the post.

comments.comment_body: Looks really good. I'd make a bit more organic wrinkles here and there if you're after hyperrealism. It looks too perfect. Light wise try to play with other environment maps and rotate them to get other effects.

Hi mashunya3d, Thanks for sharing this question with us. To make the fabric texture being more visible, we recommend increasing the intensity value of the Normal Map under Fabric, especially for the fabric with printing. Another tip is to change the light intensity and angle in Render - Light Properties. You can change them and preview the result immediately in the Interactive Render. The last tip is to increase the and image resolution in Render - Image/ Video Properties. You can change the Resolution to 300ppi to have better quality and higher resolution for the render image. So the fabric texture will be more obvious after this setting.
Thank you very much, CLO Designers the result is really better.
Pablo Quintana , thank you very much for your feedback. I will follow your advice.
